scope: Proposition 5.1 (The remaining index sequence) of the manuscript “Uniform Pluricanonical Iitaka Fibrations” (preprints/Uniform-Pluricanonical-Iitaka-Fibrations-October-3-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88c226e29ee72119), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If the canonical indices of projective klt n-folds with KX ∼Q 0 are unbounded, there is a sequence of projective Q-factorial terminal n-folds Vi, of canonical indices ri → ∞, satisfying the following properties. 1. A smooth projective resolution of Vi has irregularity zero, and Bir(Vi) is countable. 2. Every positive-dimensional rational image of Vi of dimension less than n has rationally connected smooth projective resolution. 3. Every effective Weil divisor on Vi with positive Iitaka dimension is big. 4. Let πi : Yi → Vi be the cyclic index cover, with its deck group Gi. Then Yi is terminal and KYi ∼ 0. Every Gi-equivariant rational fibration of Yi having positive-dimensional base and fibre has general-type smooth geometric generic fibre. The same assertion holds for rational fibrations of Vi, with trivial group action. Here a rational fibration has geometrically integral generic fibre, or equivalently has a relatively algebraically closed base function field.
